out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO HANDSOAP AT THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: SOAP PLACED AT THE SINK DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED BOXES OF FOOD STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE STORAGE UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE OBTAIN SHELVING AND PUT IN THIS STORAGE UNIT TO ENSURE FOOD AND FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES ARE KEPT 6IN ABOVE THE FLOOR. THIS MUST BE CORRECTED BY YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Materials Smooth, Durable, Cleanable
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE FLOOR OF THE STORAGE UNIT IN THE PARKING LOT TO NOT BE A CLEANABLE SURFACE.
violations.corrective_action: PLEASE SEAL THE FLOOR (EX. BY PAINTING) TO MAKE IT A SMOOTH, CLEANABLE SURFACE BY YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Maintenance Tools Storage
violations.observation: Maintenance tools are not being stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single-service items. OBSERVED MAINTENANCE ITEMS STORED WITH RESTAURANT ITEMS ON DRY STORAGE SHELVINGS.
violations.corrective_action: Store all maintenance tools in a manner that prevents contamination of food and food-contact surfaces. PLEASE REORGANIZE SHELVING SO THAT MAINTENANCE ITEMS ARE SEPARATE FROM FOOD ITEMS BY YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Copy of vomit and diarrhea was provided to PIC

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed open shelving unit next to the three compartment sink, chemicals for cleaning were being stored on the top shelf, above food contact surfaces ( bowls and plastic containers)
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. Person in charge moved the cleaning chemicals so they wee being stored below the clean food contact surfaces

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. A CFM arrived during the time of inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the front drink preparation area being used as a rinse/dump sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Staff were instructed to use the other sink basin at the front drink preparation area as a rinse/dump sink. Items that were rinsed in hand sink were relocated to 3 comp sink to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: crème brûlée mixture prepared at 4 am was observed 59 degrees F at 2 pm.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. Crème brûlée mixture was discarded.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: metal containers of crème brûlée stored covered and stacked on top of each other. Condensation observed inside containers of crème brûlée observed at 59 degrees F >6 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. Crème brûlée mixture was discarded and manager was trained on the aforementioned cooling methods.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: drink stirrers, spoons, scoops, etc. stored in still, ambient temperature water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The manager was instructed to pour water and wash, rinse, and sanitize utensils. Utensils to be stored dry until another method, such as storing in water 135 degrees F or above, is obtained.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no bleach test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: A bleach test kit was observed during the time of inspection.
